The only happy image in his mind is his aunt Seher. Seher is a beautiful and humble girl living with her grandfather. description: Legacy tells the story of a journey born from a child’s fate, shaped by love, betrayal, and sacrifice. After her sister’s death, Seher fights to care for her nephew Yusuf against his uncle, ruthless businessman Yaman Kırımlı. What begins as conflict blossoms into love, yet their bond is torn apart by lies, secrets, and betrayal. Even separated, their hearts carry the same pain. Seher’s tragic death leaves Yaman and Yusuf in darkness. While Yaman struggles with grief, Nana enters the mansion seeking revenge for her brother. But the bond she builds with Yusuf’s innocence and Yaman’s broken heart makes her abandon vengeance and choose love instead. After Yaman’s death, Yusuf and Nana are left alone until they cross paths with Poyraz, who teaches them to trust and hope again. Over four seasons, Legacy became more than a love story: it is a saga of loss, sacrifice, betrayal, and reborn hope.
name: Legacy - YouTube
